title: Red Hat Security Advisory: ruby security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in the Ruby programming language, including a double free issue and several integer overflow issues in the regular expression parser and compiler. These vulnerabilities affect Ruby as packaged in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related Red Hat products. The issues have been rated with moderate severity by Red Hat Product Security. Updates addressing these vulnerabilities are available through Red Hat advisories.
